dedupe_keys.name: geb geographical environmental and behavioural agent based model coupled with cwatm

description: A large-scale agent-based model of farmers coupled to a hydrological model. The Natural Hazards and Earth System Sciences paper by Kalthof, de Bruijn, de Moel, Kreibich and Aerts (6 March 2025) uses GEB, which couples farmer agents to the CWatM hydrological model, extended with subjective expected utility theory, to show that adaptive behaviour of farmers under consecutive droughts in the Bhima basin, India, can leave them more vulnerable. The paper says the latest GEB and adapted CWatM code and setup scripts are on GitHub and that model inputs, parameters and code for the study are on Zenodo (doi 10.5281/zenodo.11071746), all free to download. Coverage is any basin the user sets up, with the Bhima basin as the case. Caveats: setting up a basin needs large input data. For simulation it models how farmers' adaptation and irrigation choices change water availability and drought impacts. A related catalogue record is the rice flood damage models.
